name: samurai
intent: Side-view (+X) looping run for armored samurai: longer stride, stronger knee lift, pumped opposite arms, slight forward lean; jingasa stays seated on head.

beats.pose_description: Drive contact: near foot plants hard ahead with bent knee; far leg extended back in push-off; near arm cocked back, far arm punched forward; slight forward lean via neck.
Recoil/squash: weight compresses into near stance, near knee deep flex; far leg tucks and swings forward fast; arms start reversing.
Flight/pass: both feet off ground feel — legs cross under with high far knee tuck; elbows bent tighter for run pump; torso still leaning.
Reach: far foot stretches far forward before plant; near leg trails extended; arms at extreme opposite pump; chin slightly down.
Opposite drive contact: far foot plants ahead; near leg extended back; arm swap (near forward, far back); same lean.
Opposite recoil: far knee deep flex under weight; near leg tucks into forward swing; arms reverse.
Opposite flight/pass: near knee high tuck under torso; soft but pumped elbows; continuous forward lean.
Opposite reach into next contact: near foot stretches ahead; far leg push-off trail; arms wind toward frame-0 extremes.

plan.silhouette_story: Eight-frame side run facing +X: hard plant → squash → flight/pass → reach, then mirrored. Reads faster and more airborne than walk; armor and jingasa follow rigid limb transforms with a slight forward lean.

differs_from.idle: Idle is near-rest A-pose; run is a full airborne-feeling loop with deep knee lifts and aggressive arm pump.
differs_from.walk: Walk is a grounded march with moderate stride and soft arm pendulum; run uses larger hip swings, deeper knee flexion, tighter elbow pump, and a forward lean for speed.

plan.weapon_or_style_notes: No weapon — empty-hand sprint. Arms pump like a runner (bent elbows), not a walk pendulum or sword cut.
